note: Hand-authored seed cohort. Written by hand so the mechanism can be judged before any model pass is paid for. The production path is pipeline/predicates.js over pipeline/out/plots.json, same input the fingerprint pass used.

The Banshees of Inisherin.basis: Colm simply informs Padraic that he no longer likes him, and never produces a reason Padraic can hold on to.
Colm promises to cut off one of his own fiddle fingers for every further word, and then does it.
The people with least stake in the quarrel — Dominic, Siobhan, a miniature donkey — absorb its whole cost.
The Irish Civil War thumps away on the mainland, close enough to hear and too far to matter.
The pub, the shopkeeper and the priest track every development and none of them stop it.
A donkey's death is the point at which the quarrel stops being survivable.
Colm wants to leave music behind him and has decided that friendliness is the thing costing him the hours.
The finger business is a running joke until it is a hand that can no longer play.

Old Joy.basis: Nothing is announced; Mark has quietly stopped needing Kurt, and only Kurt is still trying.
One of them has a pregnant wife and a mortgage; the other is still performing the person they both were at twenty-five.
Kurt says the sadness has worn a hole in the joy, and does not appear to hear that he is describing them.
They part at a kerb with a handshake and an offer nobody intends to take up.
Talk radio argues American politics through the whole drive and never once touches the two men in the car.

Y tu mamá también.basis: The friendship does not blow up; it is quietly withdrawn from, and neither boy names it.
Two lifelong friends make small talk in a cafe, split the bill, and never see each other again.
A narrator keeps cutting away to the roadblocks, poverty and deaths happening just outside a frame the boys never look at.
Luisa knows she is dying and lets the trip be an ending; the boys think it is a holiday.
The whole journey is being paid for by a diagnosis none of the travellers discuss.

The Lighthouse.basis: Two keepers on a rock with no boat coming, so every disagreement has to go upward.
Killing the gull is the transgression the weather itself appears to answer.
They drink through camaraderie, then through kerosene, and the drinking is never the argument.
Wake withdraws approval as a tool, granting and revoking it to keep the younger man off balance.

The Duellists.basis: Two officers duel for sixteen years over an insult neither can any longer state.
The Napoleonic wars roll over Europe while the two of them conduct a private war at the same scale of seriousness.
Feraud fixes on d'Hubert without explanation and will not release him for a decade and a half.

Withnail and I.basis: One of them gets a job and a haircut; the other is left performing Hamlet to the wolves in the rain.
The goodbye at the park gates is brisk, ordinary, and the last one.
Every scene is conducted at a level of intoxication the film treats as weather rather than as subject.
A farce about two unemployable actors resolves into one man's untreated despair.

The Assassination of Jesse James by the.basis: Ford wants to be loved by the man he has read about since childhood, and is found tiresome instead.
James withdraws warmth without explanation and lets Ford stand in the cold of it.
James behaves for months like a man who has already decided how this ends.

Amadeus.basis: Salieri offers God his chastity and his industry in exchange for lasting, and is answered with someone else's talent.
Salieri is the only man alive who fully hears Mozart, and the only one Mozart never troubles to notice.
The Requiem is written against a deadline that turns out to be its author's own.

Ex Machina.basis: A sealed facility with no way out until someone decides there is.
Nathan drinks himself through every honest conversation in the building.

Catch Me If You Can.basis: Frank runs the night he is asked which parent he wants to live with, and every forged life afterwards is an attempt to put that evening back.
Pilot, doctor, lawyer — each self is worn well enough to pass because he has studied how men who own those lives carry themselves.
Hanratty is the only person alive who knows what Frank actually is, which is why Frank telephones him every Christmas.
He keeps returning to a father the tax office is wearing down, and the man is smaller at every visit.
Every score is a report filed to a father who will be dead before he can be impressed by it.
The bureau closes the film by employing the man it spent the film chasing.
The boy is the last person in the house to be told the marriage is finished.

Heat.basis: Hanna and McCauley sit down to coffee and discover the only man who understands either of them is the one who will have to kill him.

The 400 Blows.basis: Antoine's mother would plainly prefer him elsewhere, and the film never once lets the household be repaired.
He runs until there is only sea in front of him, and the film stops on his face.
He is delivered into an observation centre, and the state's custody is not a job offer.

The King of Comedy.basis: Pupkin's entire act is addressed to a father-substitute who finds him unbearable, and he takes the spot anyway.
He rehearses celebrity in a basement with cardboard guests until the rehearsal is indistinguishable from a career.

F for Fake.basis: Elmyr paints as Modigliani well enough that the experts sign for it, and Welles films him enjoying it.
The fakes hang in museums, and the film argues that the certainty of the men who authenticated them is the larger forgery.

Barry Lyndon.basis: Redmond Barry assembles a gentleman out of borrowed names and a purchased marriage, and the seams are visible in every frame.
The manufactured aristocrat is better at aristocracy than the men born to it, and it saves him from nothing.
Bryan sees his father at his most extravagant and least solid, and does not live long enough to see the collapse.

Shoplifters.basis: A household assembled from people who chose one another is read by the state as a crime scene.
The child's real parents are available the whole time, and are the worse option.

Boogie Nights.basis: A film crew becomes the parents, and holds for as long as the money does.
Dirk is thrown out by his mother, and everything after is an audition for a family that will keep him.

Bicycle Thieves.basis: Bruno is standing right there at the moment his father becomes a thief in front of a crowd.
The household is not broken by anyone's choice, only by not having the thing that keeps it fed.
